name: B10-0234/2024 (PPE) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It strongly criticises Azerbaijan for jailing government critics, journalists and activists on charges it calls false. It asks Azerbaijan to free named prisoners, including Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and seven Meydan TV journalists, and to let Ibadoghlu get medical treatment abroad. It also calls for European Union sanctions on Azerbaijani officials responsible for serious human rights violations.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks Azerbaijan to release prisoners and drop charges.
- The people affected are jailed activists, journalists and officials who could face European Union sanctions.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union bodies and Azerbaijan's government; no action is binding.
